description: This Dart source file provides localization support for a Flutter UI application. It includes a class for loading localized strings from ARB-like JSON assets, a delegate for Flutter's localization system, and a locale controller for managing the current app locale at runtime.

classes.name: AppLocalizations
classes.description: Manages loading and providing localized strings based on the current locale.

classes.name: _AppLocalizationsDelegate
classes.description: Implements Flutter's LocalizationsDelegate to facilitate locale-specific loading of AppLocalizations.

classes.name: AppLocaleController
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages the application's current locale, enabling runtime locale switching.

methods.name: AppLocalizations.of
methods.description: Retrieves the current AppLocalizations instance from the widget tree.

methods.name: AppLocalizations.load
methods.description: Loads localized strings for a given locale from a JSON asset.

methods.name: AppLocalizations.t
methods.description: Fetches the localized string for a given key.

methods.name: _AppLocalizationsDelegate.isSupported
methods.description: Checks if a locale is supported.

methods.name: _AppLocalizationsDelegate.load
methods.description: Loads localized resources for a given locale.

methods.name: _AppLocalizationsDelegate.shouldReload
methods.description: Determines if the delegate should reload its resources.

methods.name: AppLocaleController.setLocale
methods.description: Sets the current locale and notifies listeners.
